summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Fujitec SIR. Backend: 30/30 pytest tests passed (login all 7 roles, checklist filtering with photo_points on items 10/45/47 for 12M, full inspection create/list/get, status workflow role gating, spare-part per-role field authorization, spare-parts aggregation with filters, dashboard stats, image upload+download, PDF export, admin user create/list). Frontend: Playwright covered technician wizard (login -> header -> checklist 1M loaded -> judgment + remark -> add spare part + global remark -> submit -> lands on inspection detail); verified new inspection appears in Riwayat SIR list and Dashboard recent. Role UI verified: sales cannot see New Inspection nav and can view spare-parts page. Admin Users page loads and shows created + seeded users.

minor.issue: Rate-limit key uses request.client.host which behind ingress can be the LB IP; lockout could unintentionally apply globally.
Intentionally open (no auth) per spec — acceptable but note in docs.
Returns to_list(500); safe now but no pagination.

critical_code_review_comments: Login endpoint uses client.host for lockout key; behind ingress this may lock all users. Consider X-Forwarded-For or user-only key.
Register endpoint lowercases email but does not validate role in create_user path only in RegisterInput (fine). Consider explicit role validation.

Dashboard 'recent' slices first 6 docs BEFORE sorting by inspection_date; sort happens after slice so 'recent' is technically the latest by created_at (docs already sorted desc), which is fine but potentially confusing.
PDF endpoint accepts optional auth via query string but never validates it, so anyone with an inspection id can download the PDF.
seed_data_creation: Test created inspections with job_number TEST-JOB-001 and TESTJOB999, spare parts TEST_BrakePad/TEST_Roller/TEST Brake Pad, and a few test_user_<ts>@example.com users. Admin user creation test cleans up its created user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -o addopts=''` from /app. Frontend uses localStorage keys 'sir_token' and 'sir_user'; login via demo-<Role> buttons + login-submit. Note: register lowercases email — always compare emails case-insensitively.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests after fixing test-side email-case bug.
